main_text.p: paulò ante, acciderit (hi Romam ob caufam fimillimam deportati erant) metuiffe, ideoque maturandum decretum cenfuiffe. Archonis fententiam fecuti funt multi, eorumque ftudio prætor ipse refectus. Polybius magister equitum defignatus, decretum confeftim factum ex Archonis mente, deque eo per Polybium iftuc Q. Marcius Conful Romanus, qui jam cum exercitu fuo ex Theffalia in Macedoniam penetraverat, certior factus quanquàm Romanus Conful: ne fine caufa focios fatiga-ret, & impendiis oneraret, (nam fupera-ta tranfitus difficultate non opus fibi iis effe autumabat,) auxiliis his uti eo tempore non voluerit. Sed anno fequente, cum de rerum fummâ certamen inftaret, & Perfeus omnes vires fuas contraxiffet, à confule L. Æmilio auxilia cadé fatis valida evocata funt, operamque fortem atque utilem extremo prælio Romanis præftitére: Achæique laudem & gratiam fociorum meruère. Sed nunquàm & nufquàm dormitat calumnia-tor. Ecce enim cum anno proximo decé legati à Romanis in Macedoniam effent miffi, qui res regionis illius cum L. Æmi-lio imperatore ordinarent, Callicrates cum aliis, eodem miflus à fuis, vir inge-nii verè improbi, omnes eos, qui ab ipfo

page.notes: The lower left, below the last full line, has overlapping fragments of broken lines that I could not read. They are probably show-through or bleed from the other side, and I have given them placeholders. The catchword "in" stands at the lower right. The printed text ends with "ab ipfo". The "ingenii" and "verè" lines overlap at the left edge and are read with some doubt. I have marked no word with [?].
